page_note: 整页只有一张图：OECD《Figure 3.7》按受教育程度分组的三面板柱形+菱形标记图，显示两轮周期间识字能力平均分差，下方为长篇注释与来源。

heading.title: Change in literacy proficiency between cycles, by educational attainment
heading.subtitle: Adjusted and unadjusted difference in mean literacy scores between cycles (Cycle 2 minus Cycle 1); 25-65 year-olds

figures.source_line: Source: OECD (2018[4]; 2015[5]; 2012[6]), Survey of Adult Skills (PIAAC) databases, http://www.oecd.org/skills/piaac/publicdataandanalysis/ (accessed on 23 September 2024); Table A.3.11 (L) in Annex A.

components.evidence: legend '□■ Unadjusted ◇◆ Adjusted': diamond markers overlaid on each country's bar in all three panels
bars hang below a bold zero line down to ticks -10, -20, -30, -40, -50
a heavy horizontal rule drawn at 0 across the full width of each of the three panels
note: 'Darker colours denote differences that are statistically significant at the 5% level'
Chile and United States columns are empty in the 'Below upper secondary' panel; note: 'change ... is not reported'
one legend row above the top panel governs all three panels; no per-panel legend
'Unadjusted / Adjusted' legend sits between the subtitle and the first panel
country names drawn once above panel 1 and once below panel 3, serving all three panels
three stacked panels of the same chart: Below upper secondary, Upper secondary, Tertiary
dark blue filled banner at the right of each panel reads 'Below upper secondary', 'Upper secondary', 'Tertiary'
each panel prints its own 20 ... -50 tick column at the left edge
'Note: Does not include adults who in Cycle 2 ...' and 'Source: OECD (2018[4]; ...' below the plot
country names such as 'Flemish Region (BE)' set vertically at 90 degrees above and below the panels
grey band labelled 'Round, Cycle 1:' with groups '1', '2', '3' above the country tick row
category label 'Poland*'; note: '*Caution is required in interpreting results ...'
'Score-point difference' printed above the top tick '20' at the left of panel 1
bare ticks 20 ... -50; scale word only in axis title 'Score-point difference'
'Flemish Region (BE)' and 'England (UK)' axis labels printed in blue, all other country names in black
27 countries x 3 panels x 2 series ≈ 158 drawn bars and diamonds
'Adjusted' drawn as a small diamond at the country position, read against the same 20 to -50 axis
27 vertical country labels stacked densely along the axis, e.g. 'Slovak Republic', 'New Zealand'

new_components.name: vertical_group_separator_band
new_components.evidence: pale beige vertical bands run through all three panels separating Round 1, Round 2 and Round 3 country blocks
new_components.why_it_matters: 读值时必须先确认某国属于哪个 Round 分块，色带本身不携带数值，容易被误当作阴影区间或缺失列。

new_components.name: category_axis_repeated_top_and_bottom
new_components.evidence: identical rotated country label row and 'Round, Cycle 1:' band appear both above panel 1 and below panel 3
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一套类别标签出现两次，解析出的表可能出现重复表头行，需要判断哪一行对应哪个面板。

new_components.name: panel_label_banner_right_side
new_components.evidence: panel names sit in filled dark blue rectangles to the right of the plot, not above it
new_components.why_it_matters: 面板名不在图上方而在右侧色块内，若解析器按上方标题抓取面板名，三个面板会失去区分键。

new_components.name: two_swatch_legend_for_one_series
new_components.evidence: legend shows two squares for 'Unadjusted' and two diamonds for 'Adjusted' (light = not significant)
new_components.why_it_matters: 一个系列名对应两种填色，读值时需额外判断显著性，否则同一名称下会有两类标记混淆。

difficulty_notes: 图上一个数字都没有印，纵轴刻度间隔为 10 分点，而每个面板只有约 190 px 高覆盖 20 到 -50 共 70 分点，即 1 分点≈2.7 px。要把 3、-8、-9 这类小值读到 5% 容差（±0.15、±0.4、±0.45 分点）等于要求亚像素精度，几乎不可能；即便是 -36、-45 这类大值，容差约 ±1.8-2.3 分点也只有 5-6 px，还要在 27 列密集竖条中分辨柱顶与菱形中心。其次才是标签：单个值需要面板名（右侧色块内）+国家名（90 度旋转）+Unadjusted/Adjusted 三个键才能唯一定位，共约 158 个标记。

suggestions.what_to_add: tick_marker_as_series 与 mixed_marks（柱+菱形叠加，且同名系列有深浅两种填色表示显著性）
suggestions.where_to_change: 图表生成条件行中新增“柱形上叠加点标记系列”的 style 字段，并允许同一系列名带 significance 深浅两态
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 叠加点标记系列 开/关 时，模型区分 Unadjusted 柱与 Adjusted 菱形取值的准确率对比

suggestions.what_to_add: panel_title_per_panel 的“右侧填色色块”变体（新组件 panel_label_banner_right_side）
suggestions.where_to_change: 面板标题位置字段增加 right_banner 取值，并让 panel_key 进入记录键
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 面板名位于上方标题 vs 右侧色块 两种排布下，panel_key 是否被正确写入表行

suggestions.what_to_add: per-mark 可读精度（约 158 个标记、刻度间隔 10 分点、无数值标签）
suggestions.where_to_change: readable 判定从布尔门槛改为按标记给出可达精度，与刻度像素密度绑定
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 每分点像素数（2.7 px/分点）分档下，5% 容差命中率随密度衰减曲线

suggestions.where_to_change: 类别轴样式字段：分组带（Round, Cycle 1: 1/2/3）、轴标签上下重复、分组分隔色带
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 类别轴重复/分组带 开关 时，解析表是否产生重复表头或错位的国家-面板对应

suggestions.what_to_add: heading 五分拆：figure_number、title、subtitle、unit_text（Score-point difference，置于顶刻度之上）
suggestions.where_to_change: 记录的标题字段拆成编号/标题/副标题/单位与单位位置（axis_title_above_axis）
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单位置于轴上方 vs 置于副标题 两种写法下，导出表是否保留分值单位
